        for name,(digest,packed) in assets.items():
            raw=gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(''.join(packed.split())))
            assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==digest,'H2_BAD_ASSET_'+name
            target=root/name
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(raw)
            print('H2_EMBEDDED_ASSET_SHA256=PASS',name,len(raw),digest)

    - name: Authenticate and unpack proven P11 source recipes
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        python3 -B - <<'PY_H1_EXTRACT'
        import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,stat,zipfile
        base=pathlib.Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
        root=base/'project'/os.environ['PACKAGE_NAME']
        tools=pathlib.Path(os.environ['P11_TOOL_DIR'])
        bundles=pathlib.Path(os.environ['P11_BUNDLES_DIR'])
        assert not tools.exists() and not bundles.exists()
        expected={'START_HIER.txt','P11_STATUS.json','P11_TESTS.log',
                  'P10_MASTER_ORIGINAL.zip','P3_R4_SOURCE_REPLAY.zip',
                  'p11_source_gate.py','p11_build_walt_off.sh','test_p11_source_gate.py',
                  'test_p11_build_dryrun.py','P11_BUILDRUNNER_DRYRUN_TESTS.log'}
        def load_valid(z,expected,manifest_name):
            info=z.infolist();names=[x.filename for x in info]
            if set(names)!=expected|{manifest_name} or len(names)!=len(set(names)):
                raise SystemExit('P11_ARCHIVE_MEMBERS_DRIFT')
            if z.testzip():raise SystemExit('P11_ZIP_CRC_FAILURE')
            for i in info:
                p=pathlib.PurePosixPath(i.filename)
                if p.is_absolute() or '..' in p.parts or '\\' in i.filename or i.is_dir() or stat.S_IFMT(i.external_attr>>16)==stat.S_IFLNK:
                    raise SystemExit('P11_UNSAFE_ARCHIVE_MEMBER:'+i.filename)
            manifest=json.loads(z.read(manifest_name))
            hashes=manifest.get('files') if manifest_name=='manifest.json' and 'files' in manifest else manifest.get('sha256')
            if set(hashes)!=expected:raise SystemExit('P11_MANIFEST_SCOPE_DRIFT')
            for n,digest in hashes.items():
                if hashlib.sha256(z.read(n)).hexdigest()!=digest:raise SystemExit('P11_HASH_MISMATCH:'+n)
            return manifest
        with zipfile.ZipFile(root) as z:
            manifest=load_valid(z,expected,'manifest.json')
            if manifest.get('kernel')!='5.4.274' or manifest.get('flashable') is not False:raise SystemExit('P11_WRONG_STAGE')
            tools.mkdir();bundles.mkdir()
            for name in ('p11_source_gate.py','p11_build_walt_off.sh','test_p11_source_gate.py','test_p11_build_dryrun.py'):
                (tools/name).write_bytes(z.read(name))
            nested={'P10_MASTER_ORIGINAL.zip':'VEUX_5_4_274_P10_WALT_KOMBI_PATCH_SAMMELPAKET.zip',
                    'P3_R4_SOURCE_REPLAY.zip':'VEUX_STOCK274_P3_GATE_R4.zip'}
            for old,new in nested.items(): (bundles/new).write_bytes(z.read(old))
        for nested_file,out_folder in [(bundles/'VEUX_STOCK274_P3_GATE_R4.zip',tools/'r4'),
                                       (bundles/'VEUX_5_4_274_P10_WALT_KOMBI_PATCH_SAMMELPAKET.zip',tools/'p10')]:
            with zipfile.ZipFile(nested_file) as zi:
                if zi.testzip():raise SystemExit('P11_NESTED_CRC_FAILURE')
                for i in zi.infolist():
                    p=pathlib.PurePosixPath(i.filename)
                    if p.is_absolute() or '..' in p.parts or '\\' in i.filename or stat.S_IFMT(i.external_attr>>16)==stat.S_IFLNK:
                        raise SystemExit('P11_NESTED_UNSAFE_ARCHIVE_MEMBER')
                zi.extractall(out_folder)
        for p in tools.rglob('*.py'):compile(p.read_bytes(),str(p),'exec')
        print('R55H1_P11_AUTHENTIC_SOURCE_TOOLS=PASS')
        PY_H1_EXTRACT

        python3 -B - <<'PY_H2_PROBE_STATUS'
        import json,os,pathlib
        p=pathlib.Path('/tmp/veux-r55h1/out/R55H4_SEVEN_REAL_HOOKS_RESULT.json')
        r=json.loads(p.read_text())
        if r.get('status')!='SEVEN_GENUINE_BAKASU_KERNEL_HOOKS_SOURCE_PORTED' or r.get('missing_hook_count')!=0:
            raise SystemExit('R55H4_REAL_SEVEN_HOOK_GATE_FAILED')
        # R55H4-R2 was independently replayed on the genuine P11-274 source;
        # this new stage is allowed to enter an isolated compiler ONLY with all 7 hooks.
        assert r['source_only'] is True
        assert r['bakasu_commit']=='d5e9e025b8b49155f8014684d64c91742b465f65'
        assert r['h3_sha256']=='ae3a7aed0ba20f334e987a369371d5f9bc93174836568d50e2a49628cd766f13'
        assert r['hook_patch_sha256']=='14744c535ebb710517987c302d0b279bc3f80c05e301ae327399192e73c90b47'
        assert r['real_git_apply_check'] and r['real_git_reverse_check']
        assert r['independent_clean_byte_identical_apply_and_reverse']
        assert len(r['hook_details'])==7 and all(x['ready'] for x in r['hook_details'].values())
        ready=True
        with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'],'a') as f:
            f.write('ready='+('true' if ready else 'false')+'\n')
        with open(os.environ['GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY'],'a') as f:

            f.write('Real kernel hook calls verified: '+str(r.get('added_hook_count','not reached'))+' / 7\n')
            for hook in r.get('missing_hook_symbols',[]):
                row=r['hook_details'][hook]
                f.write('- Missing real call: `'+hook+'` in `'+row['path']+'`\n')
            f.write('**Build authorization is NOT flash approval; compiler result is separately checked.**\n')
        print('R55H4_SEVEN_REAL_HOOKS='+str(r.get('added_hook_count',0))+'; remaining='+str(r.get('missing_hook_count',0)))
        print('R55H5_SOURCE_GATE=7_OF_7_TRUE; ACTIVE_BUILD_CONDITION=OPEN; FLASH=FORBIDDEN')
        PY_H2_PROBE_STATUS

             'script_exit':code,'p11_original_build_status':proof,'walt_enabled':False,'flash_allowed':False}

    - name: Record strict BakaSU composite archive actual compile/link result
      shell: bash
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        python3 -B - <<'PY_H5_FINAL'
        import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess
        out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/veux-r55h1/out');out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        read=lambda n:json.loads((out/n).read_text()) if (out/n).exists() else None
        bridge=read('R55H1_COMPATIBILITY.json')
        identity=read('R55H2_R2_RECONSTRUCTED_SOURCE_IDENTITY.json')
        h4=read('R55H4_SEVEN_REAL_HOOKS_RESULT.json')
        base=read('H1_P11_BASELINE_REPORT.json')
        active=read('R55H5_ACTIVE_BUILD_RESULT.json')
        real=bool(active and active.get('active_bakasu_susfs_image_proven') is True)
        if real:status='ACTIVE_BAKASU_SUSFS_TRUE_KERNEL_BUILD_PASS_NOFLASH'
        elif active:status='BLOCKED_REAL_BAKASU_SUSFS_COMPILER_OR_CONFIG'
        elif base and base.get('status')!='P11_BASELINE_BUILD_PASS':status='BLOCKED_P11_BASELINE'
        elif h4 and h4.get('status')=='SEVEN_GENUINE_BAKASU_KERNEL_HOOKS_SOURCE_PORTED':status='BLOCKED_BEFORE_REAL_COMPILER_START'
        elif bridge and bridge.get('status')!='COMPATIBLE_SOURCE_ONLY':status='BLOCKED_REAL_274_SOURCE'
        else:status='NOT_STARTED'
        res={'schema':1,'stage':'R55H5_R3_GENUINE_INLINE_BAKASU_COMPOSITE_KERNEL_BUILD',
         'status':status,'true_active_bakasu_susfs_compiled':real,
         'walt_enabled':False,'nomount_enabled':False,'vendor_abi_proven':False,
         'device_test':False,'boot_img_generated':False,'flash_allowed':False,
         'h4_genuine_hook_count':h4.get('added_hook_count') if h4 else None,
         'h4_missing_hooks':h4.get('missing_hook_count') if h4 else None,
         'source_identity_gate':identity.get('status') if identity else 'NOT_STARTED',
         'source_bridge_gate':bridge.get('status') if bridge else 'NOT_STARTED',
         'baseline_status':base.get('status') if base else 'NOT_STARTED',
         'compiler_status':active.get('status') if active else 'NOT_STARTED',
         'compiler_exits':active.get('kbuild_exit_codes') if active else None,
         'compiler_file_hashes':active.get('files') if active else {},
         'github_workflow_success_is_not_kernel_activation':True,
         'no_dummy_hook_bypass':True,'no_brene_changes':True,'no_vendor_changes':True}
        project=subprocess.run(['git','-C','project','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'],capture_output=True,text=True)
        res['project_repo_unchanged']=project.returncode==0 and project.stdout.strip()==''
        (out/'R55H5_FINAL_STATUS.json').write_text(json.dumps(res,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
        files=[]
        for f in sorted(out.iterdir()):
         if f.is_file() and f.name!='SHA256SUMS.txt':
          h=hashlib.sha256()
          with f.open('rb') as q:
           for chunk in iter(lambda:q.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(chunk)
          files.append(h.hexdigest()+'  '+f.name)
        (out/'SHA256SUMS.txt').write_text('\n'.join(files)+'\n')
        with open(os.environ['GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY'],'a') as f:
         f.write('\n### R55H5 actual BakaSU / SUSFS ARM64 compiler result (NO FLASH)\n')
         for k,v in res.items():f.write('- '+k+': '+str(v)+'\n')
        print('R55H5_TRUE_COMPILER_RESULT='+status)
        print('R55H5_ACTIVE_BAKASU_AND_SUSFS_LINK_PROVEN='+('YES' if real else 'NO'))
        print('R55H5_ARTIFACT_EVIDENCE_SHA256=PASS; NO FLASH')
        if not res['project_repo_unchanged']:raise SystemExit('R55H5_ORIGINAL_PROJECT_DIRTY')
        PY_H5_FINAL
        (cd "$R55_STAGE/out" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt)
      if: ${{ always() }}
